notes.title: Introducing Dawn Of Fear
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2886490/Dawn_Of_Fear/

Hello Everyone! We're finally introducing our new project called [b]Dawn Of Fear[/b]! - One survival horror project which the player Experience an intense survival horror journey as a investigative agent in a dark and cursed village. The quest for a leader has never been so hindered.

[h1]5 MINUTES OF GAMEPLAY[/h1]

[previewyoutube=tFshHOp--XQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The game is still in work in progress, so a lot of things will be changed.

[h1]GAME HIGHLIGHTS[/h1]

[h2]- First Person Action Shooter.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922940/01680096efabea145df308ec25ac0f695aa573d3.png[/img]

In this possessed village, there are a lot of cult followers, so stay safe!

[h2]- Huge Variety of Enemies.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922940/e40ac9e0f927319e5625dd64b44e70deae1459af.png[/img]

From normal possessed villagers to some side bosses to the main enemies.

[h2]- Open world exploration with side puzzles (For each chapter)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922940/61ad41dc73e51665c04628cc81ab7a35d4bc30d3.png[/img]

For each chapter, the game will contain at least one open world scene including:
 - Side Bosses
 - Treasures
 - Optional Loot

[h1]RELEASING PLANS[/h1]

We plan to release the game with 1 chapter only.
The other chapters will be available by DLC, so expect the price to be low for each part.

We'll discuss later about events so tune in our X/discord server here:

https://linktr.ee/blackhawkgames

- BHWK
